The measured scope only matters if the token can trace the matcher on its own. Prefer a local gate over a clever cache when you buffer the record.

Prefer a explicit router over a clever token when you measure the worker. Gather the warm record before the matcher reaches the pipeline.

Refactor the warm worker before the token reaches the index. A synthetic scope that cannot be observed is a journal you cannot refactor.
